newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi shares edge lower, services dominate.
newsitem.headline: Saudi shares edge lower, services dominate.

text.p: Saudi shares ended last week slightly lower in busy trade dominated by services sector shares, figures from the Riyadh-based Bakheet Financial Advisors (BFA) showed on Saturday.
The index ended at 162.61 points from 162.63 points on April 24.
Of the 56 companies traded, 15 rose, 27 declined and 14 were unchanged.
Services sector shares accounted for 37 percent of trading volume, which BFA put at 4.5 million shares worth about one billion riyals.
Saudi Fisheries gained 7.8 percent to 194 riyals from 180 riyals the previous week, and Saudi Hotels ended the week 6.5 percent higher at 132 riyals from last week's closing price of 124 riyals.

National Gas lost 10.1 percent to 133 riyals from a previous 148 riyals and Saudi Pharmaceutical Industries and Medical Appliances Corporation (SPIMACO) ended the week 5.7 percent lower at 183 riyals from 194 riyals.
